question: Can the DP mass-density resolution scale R0 be physically determined rather than merely chosen?

routes.evidence: tau ~ hbar/E_G remains heuristic; DP master equation takes R0 as input smoothing scale, never an output of a consistency condition
no source derives R0 from renormalization or cutoff structure
finite-R0 is itself the conjectural 2013 repair; the resolution is the free ingredient of that repair
dimensional analysis bounds ranges, not values within them

4 Angstrom <= R0 <= 1e6 Angstrom: lower bound from Donadi et al. 2021 underground radiation test; upper bound from 2024 effectiveness/self-decoherence criterion - an empirical-distinctiveness requirement, not a law of physics

firewall: A formula merely containing R0 does not determine R0; no candidate formula in the searched literature passed this test - parametrized collapse-rate expressions reparametrize the free choice rather than fix it.
burden_ledger: environmental-decoherence discrimination unresolved within much of the window
no principled determination of R0 (this audit)

sources.ref: L. Diosi, J. Phys. Conf. Ser. 442, 012001 (2013)
sources.claim: mass-density resolution conjecture; R0 a free parameter

sources.ref: S. Donadi et al., Nat. Phys. 17, 74-78 (2021), arXiv:2111.13490

sources.claim: Diosi and Penrose lines are independent; neither derives a resolution scale
